description: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
